title: IR-PRM+ with Previous-Utility Prediction: Constant Regret and Best-Iterate Convergence
abstract: arXiv:2610.19016v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Regret matching (and its variants) and counterfactual regret minimization are central algorithms in practice for normal-form and extensive-form game solving. Yet these have historically lacked the stronger theoretical convergence guarantees available to optimistic and extra-gradient methods. Recent work introduced IREG-PRM+, a regret matching variant which does have strong theoretical convergence guarantees. However, it relies on a simultaneous, extra-gradient update. IREG-PRM+ is an instance of the more general IR-PRM framework, where empirically optimistic and alternating updates often have better performance. However, the prior extra-gradient analysis does not extend to these cases. We introduce a new approach that covers both settings. For simultaneous and alternating IR-PRM+ in finite two-player zero-sum matrix games, previous-utility prediction recovers the constant-regret and convergence-rate guarantees previously obtained with ex

translated_title: 带有先前效用预测的 IR-PRM+：常数遗憾与最优迭代收敛
translated_abstract: 遗憾匹配（及其变体）和反事实遗憾最小化是实践中求解标准型博弈和扩展型博弈的核心算法。然而，这些算法历来缺乏乐观方法和额外梯度方法所具备的更强理论收敛保证。最近的工作提出了 IREG-PRM+，这是一种确实具有强理论收敛保证的遗憾匹配变体。然而，它依赖于同步的额外梯度更新。IREG-PRM+ 是更一般化的 IR-PRM 框架的一个实例，在该框架中，乐观更新和交替更新在经验上往往具有更好的性能。然而，先前的额外梯度分析无法扩展到这些情形。我们提出了一种能够同时覆盖上述两种设置的新方法。对于有限两人零和矩阵博弈中的同步和交替 IR-PRM+，先前效用预测恢复了此前通过额外梯度方法获得的常数遗憾保证和收敛速度保证……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于先前效用预测的新方法，使同步和交替更新的 IR-PRM+ 在有限两人零和矩阵博弈中都能获得常数遗憾保证与最优迭代收敛保证，克服了以往额外梯度分析无法涵盖乐观更新和交替更新的局限。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a previous-utility prediction approach that extends constant-regret and best-iterate convergence guarantees to both simultaneous and alternating IR-PRM+ in finite two-player zero-sum matrix games, overcoming the limitation that prior extra-gradient analysis could not cover optimistic and alternating updates.
